normative_extracts.quote: A scroll progress timeline maps the scroll offset of a scroll container along a specified axis to a percentage progress value from 0% to 100%.

browser_support.notes: Supported in Chromium and Safari 26; Firefox implementation in progress. Guard with @supports (animation-timeline: scroll()).

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Compositor Thread reads scroll offset directly and samples the linked animation timeline at 60/120fps without waking JS.

production_failures.symptom: Elements animated with view() remain invisible (opacity: 0) in browsers without support
production_failures.root_cause: Unconditional keyframes set initial opacity: 0 without @supports feature detection.
production_failures.mitigation: Wrap scroll-driven animation rules in @supports (animation-timeline: view()) so unsupported browsers keep default visibility.

production_failures.symptom: Scroll-linked animation lags one frame behind scroll on touch devices
production_failures.root_cause: Animating a layout-inducing property like width or top forces main-thread round-trips instead of compositor execution.
production_failures.mitigation: Animate scaleX() instead of width, or translateY() instead of top.
